jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

This position offers a base salary compensation range of C$215,000 to C$270,000 annually.

jobs.title: Director, Google Gemini Enterprise - Data & AI
jobs.description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Are you a talented leader with a proven track record for motivating teams and delivering exceptional client service?

Our Data & AI team is one of our fastest‑growing practices, with strong client demand across sectors to modernize data platforms and operationalize AI. We are seeking a highly experienced AI consulting leader to drive the growth and delivery of Google Gemini Enterprise–based solutions across our client base. This role sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and commercial execution, helping organizations unlock value from generative AI and agentic workflows.

You will lead end-to-end client engagements, from shaping AI strategy through to delivering enterprise-scale implementations, while collaborating closely with Google Cloud to co-develop solutions and accelerate joint go-to-market initiatives.

What You Will Do

Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (CIO, CTO, CDO, CFO), guiding AI-driven transformation agendas
Lead AI strategy engagements, including maturity assessments, Gemini Enterprise roadmaps, and operating model & governance design
Translate complex business challenges into clear AI-enabled opportunities and value cases
Architect end-to-end Gemini Enterprise solutions, covering data integration & grounding, agentic workflows, and security/compliance frameworks
Provide technical oversight across data, AI/ML, and cloud engineering teams to ensure cohesive delivery
Advise on scalable deployment models and enterprise integration (ERP, CRM, collaboration platforms)
Lead large-scale AI programs from pilot through enterprise rollout, ensuring quality, timelines, and value realization
Develop reusable assets and accelerators (use cases, reference architectures, deployment playbooks) to scale delivery
Build and manage strategic relationships with Google Cloud, aligning client needs with product roadmap evolution
Co-develop joint solutions and go-to-market offerings with partners and contribute to capability development
Support business development and complex pursuits, including solution shaping, proposals, and pricing models
Present Gemini Enterprise solutions to executive audiences, translating technical concepts into clear business narratives
Drive client-facing storytelling on agentic AI, productivity gains, and ROI realization
Contribute to firm thought leadership and market positioning in AI transformation

What You Bring To The Role

10+ years in consulting, technology, or AI/data leadership roles
Proven track record delivering enterprise AI or cloud transformation programs
Expertise in enterprise AI architecture and design
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLMs, enterprise data architecture, and cloud platforms (GCP preferred)
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite stakeholders
Ability to shape, position, and close complex deals
Demonstrated success contributing to business development and revenue growth
Experience with Google Cloud ecosystem and strategic alliances
Exposure to AI agents/agentic workflows and enterprise AI governance frameworks
Track record building repeatable consulting offerings and intellectual property

KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $147,000 to $192,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity
, we do what is right | Excellence
, we never stop learning and improving | Courage
, we think and act boldly | Together
, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better
, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director – AI Innovation Teams

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our new AI Innovation teams in Toronto—a bold initiative building the AI-powered future of financial analysis. We're not fine-tuning existing models or optimizing yesterday's algorithms. We're architecting the next generation: sophisticated agentic AI systems, intelligent automation that thinks, and ML capabilities that will redefine how credit analysis happens and how global financial markets consume insights.

This is AI's moment at Fitch, and we're moving decisively. We have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and we're establishing Toronto as our AI innovation center. As a Lead ML Engineer, you'll be a technical champion driving this transformation—building breakthrough ML systems that others will study, mentoring engineers who will become tomorrow's AI leaders, and establishing patterns that will scale across the organization. You're joining at the perfect inflection point: early enough to architect foundational decisions, resourced enough to execute boldly.

We need ML technologists who see greenfield opportunities as fuel rather than fear—whether you're an ML architect ready to design intelligent systems from first principles, an AI engineering leader who translates research breakthroughs into production reality, or a seasoned practitioner who recognizes that this moment demands courage over caution. If you're motivated by "let's prove this is possible" rather than "we need more data before we decide," this is a high-impact role where you'll spend less time justifying AI's potential and more time realizing it—alongside exceptional engineers who share your conviction that we're building something significant.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to remain deeply hands-on while operating at a senior level. You will contribute technical expertise, influence decision-making through strong engineering judgment, and partner closely with engineering leaders, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities

What We Offer

Ground-floor ML leadership with enterprise resources – Define the ML architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for Fitch's AI future while having the compute, research budgets, and organizational backing that most AI startups would envy; mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the most challenging technical problems
Build breakthrough ML systems that matter – Develop net-new generative AI platforms, multi-agent orchestration systems, and intelligent automation that will process billions in credit decisions; experiment with frontier models, novel architectures, and unconventional approaches; see your ML innovations directly impact how global financial markets operate
Access to cutting-edge ML infrastructure and research – Work with the latest LLMs, fine-tune foundation models, leverage enterprise-scale GPU clusters, experiment with emerging frameworks before they're mainstream, and collaborate with academic ML researchers; substantial conference and training budgets to stay at the forefront of AI innovation
Toronto as Fitch's AI center of excellence – Join our strategic investment in Toronto—one of the world's premier AI research hubs—where you'll connect with Vector Institute researchers, attend cutting-edge ML meetups, and be part of the ecosystem that's defining the future of applied AI
Shape ML governance and standards for an organization – Establish the ML engineering practices, model governance frameworks, and AI integration patterns that will guide Fitch's AI transformation; your architectural decisions will influence how a global financial services leader approaches intelligent systems
Real production impact with sophisticated ML challenges – Build ML systems that analysts and financial professionals actually use daily; solve hard problems at the intersection of NLP, document intelligence, reasoning systems, and production-scale deployment; measure your impact in both model performance and business outcomes
Accelerated career trajectory in AI leadership – High visibility to C-suite executives making billion-dollar strategic decisions; clear advancement paths to Principal ML Architect or AI Research Lead roles; opportunity to establish yourself as a recognized voice in financial AI and earn a reputation that opens doors across the industry

We'll Count On You To

Build transformative ML systems from the ground up – Design and architect net-new generative AI solutions, agentic workflows, and intelligent platforms using advanced ML frameworks (PyTorch, etc.), large language models, and emerging AI technologies that fundamentally change how analysts work and how Fitch operates
Drive breakthrough AI innovation and experimentation boldly – Lead exploration of generative AI, multi-agent systems, RAG architectures, model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and other emerging ML technologies; create cutting-edge proofs-of-concept; evaluate what's transformative versus what's hype; and turn research into production-quality AI capabilities
Define ML technical vision and architecture for the future – Shape architectural decisions for ML systems, establish ML engineering standards, drive technology and framework choices, and influence how Fitch approaches intelligent platforms and AI governance across the organization
Lead through innovation, influence, and mentorship – Mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while partnering with product squads, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate ambitious AI ideas into elegant technical solutions; foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and calculated risk-taking
Champion ML excellence while moving fast – Balance innovation velocity with ML engineering best practices; implement robust CI/CD pipelines for ML systems; develop scalable APIs (FastAPI, etc.) for model deployment; solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and production systems; and build solutions that are both breakthrough and reliable
Drive ML governance and operational excellence – Ensure adherence to AI/ML governance guidelines, monitor SLAs for AI solutions, optimize model performance and reliability, and translate complex ML concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences across distributed teams
Shape team culture and technical direction – Help define how our AI innovation teams operate, what "good" looks like for ML engineering, and how we balance exploration with delivery; model the curiosity, boldness, and technical rigor needed to succeed in a greenfield ML innovation environment

What You Need To Have

Deep ML technical expertise – 12+ years of professional experience building production AI/ML systems, with strong proficiency in Python, ML algorithms (from classical techniques to deep learning), and modern ML frameworks; proven track record of delivering advanced generative AI and ML solutions
ML architectural mastery and greenfield experience – Demonstrated experience designing scalable ML systems from scratch; deep understanding of ML system architecture, model deployment patterns, and the ability to make bold architectural decisions for AI platforms in ambiguous environments
Advanced generative AI expertise – Extensive hands-on experience developing and integrating generative AI solutions, working with large language models, building agentic systems, implementing RAG architectures, and training/fine-tuning neural networks using frameworks like PyTorch
Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field
Production ML engineering excellence – Deep understanding of ML operations, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), workflow orchestration (Airflow), automated testing for ML systems, and API development for model deployment
Technical leadership and influence – Track record of mentoring and coaching engineers, driving ML initiatives in fast-moving environments, leading through technical excellence and influence rather than authority, and building credibility through results and vision
Innovation and experimentation mindset – Demonstrated history of exploring emerging ML technologies, building AI proofs-of-concept, learning from failures, and translating cutting-edge research into production systems; comfort with ambiguity and rapid technological change
Outstanding collaboration and communication – Ability to articulate ML technical vision to diverse audiences, work effectively with product squads and business partners, translate complex AI/ML concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives

What Would Make You Stand Out

Cutting-edge AI research to production experience – Track record of taking breakthrough AI capabilities from research/prototype to production-scale deployment; experience supporting seamless transitions from experimentation to enterprise-grade ML systems with real users
ML thought leadership and technical strategy – History of establishing technical direction for ML initiatives, contributing to open-source ML projects, speaking at AI/ML conferences, publishing research, or writing about practical applications of emerging AI technologies
Multi-agent and agentic systems expertise – Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems, or complex AI orchestration platforms that go beyond simple LLM integrations
Advanced cloud-native ML infrastructure – Deep expertise building sophisticated ML infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, model serving platforms, and cloud-native AI systems at scale; experience optimizing cost and performance of production LLM deployments
Financial services or analytical domain knowledge – Understanding of analytical workflows, credit analysis processes, regulatory requirements, financial data products, or how ML enables better financial decision-making; familiarity with credit ratings agencies is a significant advantage
Startup or innovation team experience – History of building greenfield ML products, working in fast-paced AI innovation environments, or being part of 0-to-1 ML initiatives within larger organizations where you shaped technical direction
Toronto AI/ML community connection – Active participation in Toronto's AI/ML research or engineering communities, connections to academic ML research groups, or strong interest in being part of Toronto's world-class AI ecosystem

If you're ready to build transformative ML systems with organizational backing, talented colleagues, and the resources to succeed—this is the moment to join us.

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch'

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

À propos du poste

McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique
pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

Exigences de base

13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique.
Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

Compétences et expériences privilégiées

Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques

Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Digital Experience
to lead architecture strategy across solution architecture, application architecture, legacy solution modernization, and digital experience management. This leader will set the vision for modern, scalable, secure, and customer-centered technology solutions that support enterprise priorities and improve business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead architecture practices that connect business strategy to technology execution. You will partner with senior leaders, product, engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy environments, guide digital experience strategy, and strengthen architecture governance. You will also develop leaders, influence enterprise decisions, and help teams deliver high-impact technology solutions in a complex, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise architecture practice across solution architecture, application architecture, modernization, and digital experience management.
Define architecture standards, roadmaps, governance models, and decision frameworks that enable scalable and secure technology delivery.
Partner with executive and senior business leaders to align architecture strategy with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.
Lead legacy application and platform modernization strategies, including rationalization, cloud migration, integration, automation, and technical debt reduction.
Guide digital experience architecture to improve usability, accessibility, performance, reliability, and end-to-end customer and employee journeys.
Advise teams on modern architecture patterns, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, data integration, identity, security, and observability.
Oversee architecture portfolio planning, vendor strategy, investment recommendations, and measurable value delivery.
Build and develop architecture leaders and teams through coaching, talent planning, performance management, and inclusive leadership practices.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional technology experience, including 6+ years of leadership experience in architecture, engineering, application delivery, digital platforms, or technology transformation.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience leading enterprise, solution, or application architecture across large-scale technology environments.
Lead the design and modernization of enterprise solution architectures, leveraging AI-enabled platforms and emerging technologies to drive innovation, scalability, and business value.
Experience developing architecture strategy, roadmaps, standards, governance, and executive-level recommendations.
Experience leading modernization of legacy applications, platforms, or digital capabilities.
Experience managing leaders, architecture teams, or cross-functional technology teams.
Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to influence strategy and delivery.
Experience with budget planning, vendor management, portfolio prioritization, or technology investment decisions.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with cloud platforms, API strategy, microservices, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
Experience with digital experience management, customer experience platforms, portals, mobile/web applications, or omnichannel solutions.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, retail, or other regulated enterprise environments.
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture review boards, capability modeling, or application portfolio management.
Experience leading large-scale transformation programs across multiple teams, functions, or business units.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technology decisions for business audiences.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Nanaimo Forest Products Ltd. (NFPL), operating as Harmac Pacific, is a privately owned British Columbia–based, partially employee-owned company producing approximately 400,000 tonnes per year of Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp, one of the highest-value pulp products globally. Since 2010, NFPL has invested more than $300 million in capital improvements across its pulp and energy operations, including significant investments in production infrastructure, renewable energy generation, and facility modernization.
The company serves international markets across Asia, North America, and Europe, and is recognized as both a specialty and commodity pulp producer, leveraging unique fibre inputs such as Douglas Fir, Hemlock, and Red Cedar to produce differentiated grades.
A key strategic differentiator for NFPL is its integrated energy platform. The Harmac Pacific site includes a biomass-fueled cogeneration facility that converts residual fibre inputs—such as sawdust and bark—into renewable electricity and process steam. Since 2014, the company has supplied carbon-neutral power to BC Hydro, generating enough energy to serve more than 28,000 homes annually. This contracted power business provides a stable and complementary revenue stream alongside the cyclical pulp market.
NFPL Is Actively Advancing Energy Growth Initiatives, Including

Expansion of generation capacity through new boiler and turbine infrastructure
Evaluation and relocation of existing boiler assets to increase output
Participation in funding programs (e.g., CleanBC, Investment in Forestry Industry Transformation (IFIT), and infrastructure financing)
Exploration of low-carbon energy solutions and renewable energy credits

These initiatives represent a significant opportunity to enhance long-term EBITDA stability and strengthen the company’s sustainability profile.
In Addition To Its Operating Assets, NFPL Owns Strategically Located Industrial Land Adjacent To The Harmac Site. This Land Is Currently Under Consideration For Industrial Rezoning And Future Development And Offers
Proximity to deep-water port access
Existing infrastructure, including water treatment and energy systems
Potential for development into an industrial park, logistics hub, or complementary processing operations

This landholding provides long-term growth optionality and diversification potential beyond NFPL’s core pulp and energy businesses.
NFPL employs more than 350 people and supports over 1,000 jobs in the region. Its ownership model is unique:
25% employee-owned
Remaining ownership held by BC-based investors across three holding entities
Governed by a six-member Board, with equal representation among ownership groups

The company operates with a lean, collaborative, and hands-on culture, where leaders are expected to be actively involved in the business and contribute broadly to performance and decision-making.
VISION

To produce and supply premium Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) pulp to global markets through operational excellence, innovation, and a commitment to quality, sustainability, and teamwork.
MISSION

To be a world-class, employee-owned pulp producer recognized for delivering high-quality products, operating sustainably, and competing successfully in global markets.
VALUES

Quality:
Guided by the principle that "Quality is the Key" to success.
Sustainability:
Commitment to environmental stewardship, renewable energy generation, and responsible resource use.
Collaborative Teamwork:
Emphasis on employee ownership, partnership, and shared success.
Innovation:
Use of technology, creativity, and continuous improvement to remain competitive.
Position Overview

The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting to the General Manager & CEO and working closely with the Board and ownership groups.
This is a hands-on, operational leadership role in a lean organization. The CFO will lead all financial functions while contributing broadly to strategic planning, capital allocation, and operational decision-making. The role requires strong capability in providing stewardship for their core pulp business which includes navigating a capital-intensive, globally exposed, and cyclical commodity business, but also helping to find strategic levers to expand their power generation and real estate development aspirations.
As a trusted advisor to the General Manager & CEO and Board, the CFO plays a central role in aligning financial planning, risk management, and infrastructure development to help diversify and strengthen recuring revenue for the group with direct responsibility for operational and capital budgets, financial controls, audit processes, enterprise risk management, insurance, and legislative compliance, while ensuring sound stewardship of resources and long-term financial sustainability. As a senior leader, the CFO will foster strong working relationships across the organization and with external stakeholders including government, auditors, industry partners, and regulatory bodies.
The role is responsible for building and sustaining high-performing teams, mentoring, and creating a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement. With a strong focus on data-informed decision-making, risk mitigation, and operational effectiveness, this position is critical to ensuring that Harmac Pacific operates with integrity, resilience, and strategic agility in a competitive pulp industry landscape.

As a Director, Cloud Governance
you will play a pivotal leadership role in defining and executing the Scopely’s Cloud Governance strategy. This team will define, implement, and enforce the policies and controls that govern how cloud infrastructure is used across a decentralized organization of game, platform, and product teams.

This role is critical to bringing structure, consistency, and guardrails to Scopely’s cloud footprint, and will be key in modernizing our overall governance posture. As a central leader, you will drive alignment across highly autonomous teams and translate governance into practical, adoptable solutions while balancing control and development velocity.

This is a foundational leadership role; you will establish governance from the ground up, introduce scalable and enforceable controls, and drive adoption and buy-in across various teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders.

What You Will Do

Build & Lead Cloud Governance

Build and lead a Cloud Governance team
Define the operating model for how governance partners with game teams, security, and FinOps
Establish clear ownership and enforcement mechanisms for cloud policies

Define & Enforce Cloud Guardrails

Design and implement enforceable controls across AWS and GCP, including:
AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies (SCPs)
GCP Organization Policies and IAM constraints

Establish guardrails around:
Resource provisioning and service usage
Region restrictions and data residency
Identity and access management
Network architecture and environment isolation

Own the mandate to enforce policies, including the ability to restrict or block non-compliant usage

Standardize Cloud Structure

Define and implement standards for:
AWS account structure and GCP project/folder hierarchy
Environment segmentation (prod, staging, dev)
Naming conventions and resource organization

Bring consistency across a fragmented, multi-team cloud footprint

Tagging & Governance

Ensure all resources are attributable (ownership, environment, cost center)
Enable downstream cost allocation and operational visibility

Stakeholder Partnership

Partner with Security to align governance with security and compliance requirements
Work directly with game teams to safely roll out and drive adoption of policies and standards

AI-Forward Governance & Automation

Define and execute an AI-native vision for cloud governance, transforming the function into an intelligent, policy-driven operating model powered by autonomous and agentic systems
Establish the organization’s strategy for governance autonomy, defining where fully autonomous operations, human-on-the-loop oversight, and human-in-the-loop approvals are appropriate based on risk, business impact, and compliance requirements

10+ years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE
3–5+ years leading teams in complex, multi-team environments
Experience operating in decentralized or federated engineering organizations
Proven track record implementing cloud governance and enforcement at scale
Experience managing or influencing environments with $50M+ cloud spend
Deep hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
Experience with policy-as-code and governance tooling (e.g., OPA, Sentinel, AWS Config)
Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and multi-account design

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 261595

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Role

The Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering is responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and continuously enhancing a fully automated control and governance framework for cloud platforms within a highly regulated global financial institution. This role provides enterprise leadership to ensure that cloud infrastructure and platform services are designed, built, and operated with appropriate risk management, regulatory compliance, and security controls embedded by default across the full technology lifecycle.

Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President & Global Head, Global Banking & Markets Engineering, the role blends governance accountability with a strong engineering mindset. The Director partners closely with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to define a comprehensive control inventory, while leading the automation and enforcement of those controls through scalable cloud engineering frameworks. This position plays a critical role in enabling safe cloud adoption at scale, supporting innovation while meeting regulatory and audit expectations.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of the cloud controls and governance framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory, risk, security, and audit requirements applicable to financial services.
Partner with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to establish and maintain a comprehensive, well‑defined control inventory for cloud infrastructure and platform services.
Lead the automation and enforcement of controls across the cloud lifecycle, embedding guardrails into engineering platforms, pipelines, and reference architectures.
Build and lead a high‑performing team of 3–4 specialists responsible for translating control requirements into scalable engineering solutions and reusable frameworks.
Collaborate with product and platform Technical Program Managers to ensure controls are captured early in design and consistently applied through build, deployment, and operations.
Define and oversee engineering‑led governance mechanisms, including dashboards, interfaces, and metrics that provide real‑time visibility into control effectiveness and compliance posture.
Influence cloud strategy and platform roadmaps to ensure risk and control considerations are addressed without compromising developer productivity or time to market.
Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and management reviews by providing clear evidence of automated control design and operation.
Establish standards, policies, and patterns that promote secure‑by‑design and compliant‑by‑default cloud engineering practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
Extensive experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, or cloud security within largescale, regulated environments.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automated controls, policy‑as‑code, and governance frameworks across IaaS and PaaS platforms.
Proven people‑leadership experience, including building and leading small, specialized technical teams.
Experience in financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Deep familiarity with public cloud platforms and modern control enforcement techniques (e.g., policy‑as‑code, CI/CD integration, cloud security posture management).
Experience engaging with regulators, auditors, and second‑line risk functions on technology control matters.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior technology and risk leaders.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Director, AI Business Enablement

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a transformational leader who can serve as a strategic peer to senior business executives and drive AI-powered business transformation across an entire Line of Business or Function. As a Senior Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own the full AI transformation ambition for your domain — setting the vision, building the opportunity pipeline, and ensuring executive alignment from ideation through to program framing and handoff.

You will be expected to challenge, provoke, and co-develop transformation roadmaps with senior business leaders — bringing a combination of strategic rigour, AI fluency, and the credibility that comes from having built and shipped solutions, not just recommended them.

Your responsibilities will include:

Executive partnership: Holding sustained, peer-level strategic relationships with senior business leaders (SVP+); co-developing and communicating the AI-enabled transformation vision for your domain
Pipeline origination: Identifying, sizing, and prioritising a rigorous pipeline of AI transformation opportunities — including new ideas not yet on the business’ horizon — with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for large business problems and validating them through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Helping leaders fundamentally rethink business processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Partnering with business leaders beyond ideation — through business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing — to ensure ambition translates into execution
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our world-class AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between the transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise pattern recognition: Surfacing reuse opportunities, multi-LOB programs, and horizontal themes that no single vertical would initiate alone
Team leadership: Leading and developing a small team of high-performing leaders aligned to sub-segments within your domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 15+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of building AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by accountability for delivery outcomes
Possess the executive gravitas and communication skills to challenge and influence senior business leaders (SVP+) as a peer
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Lead AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with direct visibility to Group Head and Operating Committee level leadership at RBC
Shape the mandate and culture of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

jobs.title: Cloud Architecture & Engineering, Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations. They enable the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centres to optimise performance and minimise downtime. Those in site reliability engineering at PwC will focus on enabling the reliability, scalability, and performance of organisational technology infrastructure. This will include working to automate processes, monitor systems, and resolve incidents to maintain a seamless user experience.

Meaningful work you’ll be part of

As a Director, Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve business issues, deliver high-quality client service and operational efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

You will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of cloud strategy, architecture, engineering, and client engagement.  
This role combines deep technical cloud expertise with strategic leadership, practice development, and team coaching.  
You will shape and scale cloud capabilities, guide clients through complex transformation journeys, and help drive PwC’s cloud first vision. 
You will be responsible for designing and governing enterprise grade cloud architectures while also driving advisory engagements, leading teams, strengthening client relationships, and contributing to the innovation pipeline for cloud-based solutions and assets. 
This role requires a seasoned cloud leader who can operate fluently across business strategy, modern cloud architectures, and hands-on technical depth—while mentoring teams and influencing both internal and client executives.

Cloud Architecture & Engineering Leadership

Lead the design, governance, and implementation of end-to-end cloud architectures aligned to business goals and industry best practices. 
Architect scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
Develop cloud foundation blueprints, reference architectures, and reusable patterns. 
Oversee the design and optimization of Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE) and containerized environments. 
Guide the development and automation of cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, ARM, etc.). 
Provide technical guidance on compute, storage, networking, security, identity, data services, and DevOps tooling. 

Cloud Advisory & Client Engagement

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive-level stakeholders, helping them define and execute cloud strategies and operating models. 
Assess existing environments, develop modernization roadmaps, and oversee cloud migration programs. 
Lead proposal creation, solutioning activities, statements of work, and client presentations. 
Communicate complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences clearly and effectively. 
Identify and prioritize client use cases and translate business requirements into architectural approaches and execution plans. 

Practice & Team Leadership

Build, lead, and mentor teams of cloud architects, engineers, and technical specialists. 
Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and cloud innovation. 
Recruit and grow diverse technical talent, ensuring strong career development and retention. 
Collaborate with practice leadership to define strategic direction, emerging offerings, and go-to-market assets. 
Lead initiatives that strengthen practice foundations: capability models, delivery frameworks, accelerators, patterns, and reusable assets. 

Innovation, Delivery & Thought Leadership

Lead technical innovation cycles to evaluate, test, and showcase new cloud technologies, tools, and architectures. 
Drive and participate in hands-on cloud prototyping, labbing, and solution validation. 
Develop technical demos, asset-driven solutions, and market-aligned accelerators. 
Present at internal and external events, contributing to PwC’s thought leadership presence. 
Maintain active engagement with cloud provider alliances and product engineering teams to share early insights and influence product evolution. 

Experiences And Skills you’ll use To Solve 

Technical Expertise

Extensive experience in cloud architecture and engineering across AWS (primary), Azure, and/or GCP. 
Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, microservices, serverless architectures, and modern DevOps practices. 
Hands-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform strongly preferred), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Argo, etc.), and automated deployment patterns. 
Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, network segmentation, encryption, monitoring, cost optimization, and governance frameworks. 
Experience supporting modernization programs such as application migration, refactoring, API strategies, and technical debt remediation. 
AI-assisted development and prior experience deploying agentic workloads and MLOps pipelines is an asset.

Leadership & Consulting Skills

Demonstrated experience leading cloud-focused teams and initiatives in a complex, multistakeholder environment. 
Strong executive communication skills suitable for client-facing consulting environments. 
Ability to bridge business and technical perspectives and articulate value propositions, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs. 
Strategic mindset with a bias toward execution, innovation, and measurable impact. 

Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
Significant cloud architecture and engineering leadership experience. 
Preferred:  AWS Solutions Architect (Professional); Azure or GCP Architect certifications; Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or CKAD; Terraform Associate Certification.
Ability to obtain Government of Canada Security Clearance; Level 2 security clearance is an asset.
This role does not require professional engineering licensure and is not classified as a formal engineering position under provincial regulatory definitions. While individuals with a P.Eng designation are welcome to apply, the responsibilities of this role do not involve the practice of professional engineering as defined by applicable legislation.
PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer. 

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $197,000 - $247,000. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

jobs.description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

À propos du poste

McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique
pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

Exigences de base

13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique.
Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

Compétences et expériences privilégiées

Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques

Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Digital Experience
to lead architecture strategy across solution architecture, application architecture, legacy solution modernization, and digital experience management. This leader will set the vision for modern, scalable, secure, and customer-centered technology solutions that support enterprise priorities and improve business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead architecture practices that connect business strategy to technology execution. You will partner with senior leaders, product, engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy environments, guide digital experience strategy, and strengthen architecture governance. You will also develop leaders, influence enterprise decisions, and help teams deliver high-impact technology solutions in a complex, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise architecture practice across solution architecture, application architecture, modernization, and digital experience management.
Define architecture standards, roadmaps, governance models, and decision frameworks that enable scalable and secure technology delivery.
Partner with executive and senior business leaders to align architecture strategy with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.
Lead legacy application and platform modernization strategies, including rationalization, cloud migration, integration, automation, and technical debt reduction.
Guide digital experience architecture to improve usability, accessibility, performance, reliability, and end-to-end customer and employee journeys.
Advise teams on modern architecture patterns, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, data integration, identity, security, and observability.
Oversee architecture portfolio planning, vendor strategy, investment recommendations, and measurable value delivery.
Build and develop architecture leaders and teams through coaching, talent planning, performance management, and inclusive leadership practices.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional technology experience, including 6+ years of leadership experience in architecture, engineering, application delivery, digital platforms, or technology transformation.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience leading enterprise, solution, or application architecture across large-scale technology environments.
Lead the design and modernization of enterprise solution architectures, leveraging AI-enabled platforms and emerging technologies to drive innovation, scalability, and business value.
Experience developing architecture strategy, roadmaps, standards, governance, and executive-level recommendations.
Experience leading modernization of legacy applications, platforms, or digital capabilities.
Experience managing leaders, architecture teams, or cross-functional technology teams.
Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to influence strategy and delivery.
Experience with budget planning, vendor management, portfolio prioritization, or technology investment decisions.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with cloud platforms, API strategy, microservices, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
Experience with digital experience management, customer experience platforms, portals, mobile/web applications, or omnichannel solutions.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, retail, or other regulated enterprise environments.

This is an exciting leadership opportunity within Commercial Banking to shape the future of how data powers business decisions across Canada and the U.S.

As Director, Data Foundations, Automation & Information Infrastructure, you will lead a highly technical team responsible for delivering trusted, curated, and scalable data assets that support reporting, analytics, AI, and strategic decision-making across Commercial Banking. You will oversee data engineering, data operations, information infrastructure, and business-managed applications while influencing the broader Commercial Banking data strategy.

The role combines banking knowledge, technical leadership, people management, and strategic thinking. As the organization continues its journey toward cloud modernization, AI-enabled automation, Client 360 capabilities, and near real-time data delivery, this leader will play a critical role in shaping the future state of Commercial Banking's data ecosystem.

This opportunity is ideal for a banking-savvy technology leader who enjoys building high-performing teams, solving complex data challenges, driving modernization initiatives, and translating business needs into scalable technical solutions.

About This Role

The Director, Data Foundations leads the team responsible for building, managing and continuously improving the curated data that powers Commercial Banking. This includes client, financial, client activity and master data, along with the other key business data sets that reporting, analytics and AI teams across the organization rely on to make decisions.

The Director owns the end-to-end data lifecycle, from requirements, data modeling and architecture, through ETL and pipeline development, to the reliable production of trusted data within established service levels. The role partners with business, analytics, AI, Technology and Data Governance partners to ensure data is accurate, well documented and easy to use, and leads the ongoing modernization of data platforms and practices.

The ideal candidate combines deep data management expertise with strong people leadership and a high standard for quality.

Why This Role Matters

Trusted, well-managed data is the foundation for sound decisions, effective and trusted reporting, and the responsible use of AI. This role directly contributes to:

Consistent, reliable data that supports executive reporting and business decision-making
Curated data assets that allow reporting, analytics and AI teams to focus on insights
A scalable, modern data ecosystem that keeps pace with evolving business needs
Strong data quality and control practices aligned to BMO’s data governance standards

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy and Architecture

Define and deliver the Data Foundations strategy and roadmap, aligned to business, CDAO and enterprise data priorities
