Job Description

Transform How Global Transaction Banking Leverages Data, Analytics & AI

As the Director, Data Platform Engineering
, you will define and execute the strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for the Global Transaction Banking (GTB) Data Platform
. Built on Databricks
, the platform serves as the foundation for next-generation data products, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical transaction banking capabilities.

You will lead high-performing engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions while establishing modern engineering practices, platform standards, and delivery excellence across the organization. This role requires a technology leader who combines deep expertise in data engineering and distributed systems with a passion for developing talent, driving innovation, and delivering business outcomes at scale.

Mandate:
Own the strategy, engineering delivery, and operational excellence of the GTB Data Platform, enabling trusted data, advanced analytics, AI innovation, and next-generation transaction banking capabilities through a modern Databricks-powered ecosystem.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Platform Leadership

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the GTB Data Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
Lead the evolution of the Databricks platform, establishing a scalable, secure, and resilient foundation for analytics, data products, AI, and operational workloads.
Drive platform modernization, engineering transformation, automation, and AI-enabled development practices.
Establish engineering and data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for data, APIs, integration, and platform services.
Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations leaders to prioritize investments and accelerate business outcomes.

Engineering & Delivery Leadership

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for data platforms, data products, APIs, streaming services, and cloud-native applications.
Oversee end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for architecture, system design, engineering standards, and modernization initiatives.
Drive engineering excellence through adoption of DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability engineering, and platform engineering practices.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical engineering, platform, operational, and delivery issues.

Data & Technology Leadership

Champion modern data architecture practices, including data products, event-driven architectures, real-time processing, and distributed computing.
Ensure effective governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and platform observability across the GTB ecosystem.
Drive adoption of data and AI capabilities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business decision-making.
Promote reuse, standardization, and scalability of platform capabilities across GTB technology domains.

Financial, Vendor & Governance Management

Accountable for platform investment planning, budget management, forecasting, and delivery performance.
Manage strategic vendor relationships and global delivery partners to achieve business and engineering objectives.
Establish governance processes, performance metrics, and operational controls to ensure transparency and predictable outcomes.
Identify and manage strategic technology, delivery, security, and operational risks.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and senior technical talent.
Build a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, accountability, customer value, and technical excellence.
Drive workforce planning, succession management, capability development, and organizational growth.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship.

Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Technology Management

12+ years of progressive technology experience with significant experience leading large engineering teams and complex technology portfolios.
Proven success leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical professionals.
Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience managing budgets, strategic investments, vendors, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

Data Platform Engineering

Deep expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
Extensive experience with Databricks, including platform architecture, engineering, optimization, governance, and operational management.
Strong experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, data products, metadata management, lineage, governance, and data lifecycle management.
Experience building and scaling analytical, operational, and AI-ready data platforms.

Engineering & Architecture

Strong foundation in modern programming languages (Java, Python) and API design (REST, GraphQL).
Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native platform delivery.
Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and DevSecOps / CI/CD practices.
Proven experience building event-driven, real-time data architectures at enterprise scale.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Confluent, Solace, or Apache Flink.
Familiarity with graph or document data models (Neo4J, MongoDB).
Experience with observability tooling such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Datadog.
Exposure to OpenShift or other enterprise Kubernetes distributions.

Success Profile

The Successful Candidate Will

Define and execute the vision for the GTB Data Platform.
Scale and modernize a Databricks-centric data ecosystem.
Build and lead world-class data and platform engineering teams.
Deliver secure, resilient, and scalable data products and services.
Advance AI, analytics, and data-driven business capabilities.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability.
Influence technology strategy and transformation outcomes across Global Transaction Banking.

Why Join Us

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of data, analytics, and AI across Global Transaction Banking. You will lead the evolution of a strategic Databricks-powered platform, build exceptional engineering teams, and drive transformative outcomes that directly impact clients, products, and business growth.

Team:
You will lead distributed engineering teams across New York
, Toronto
, and Bangalore

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform

, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About You

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.
Employees receive 25 days of paid time off per year. After 5 years of employment, employees receive 30 days per year.
Appfire provides comprehensive coverage through Empire Health, including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Additional protection includes life insurance, critical illness coverage, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability insurance.
To promote health and well-being, Appfire offers a yearly sport allowance of CAD 600, which can be used to cover the cost of various fitness or outdoor activities from gym memberships to sports equipment.
Volunteering - Every employee receives 3 fully paid days each year to participate in Appfire Town, our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program supporting local communities.

Market recognition

Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Data Platform will lead Zynga's centralized data platform and product strategy, managing one of the largest data footprints in the gaming industry—billions of daily gameplay events flowing through a cloud-native stack spanning real-time ingestion, a petabyte-scale warehouse, experimentation, and a self-serve metrics and AI platform. Operating with high autonomy and direct executive sponsorship, you will act as a pathfinder: empowering our global studios to extract maximum value from central data and transforming the group to an AI-first way of working. This highly visible role is based in Toronto and partners closely with studio leaders, central teams, and executives across Zynga's global labels. Relocation support is available.

What You'll Do

Craft data product strategy: Define, roadmap, and execute the product strategy for Zynga's centralized data products, translating vision into initiatives that empower global studios.
Drive AI adoption: Champion an AI-first approach, pushing teams to innovate and leverage clean, trusted data for advanced AI/ML capabilities.
Lead a global team: Manage, mentor, and grow a diverse team of ~60 across North America, Israel, and India—including Directors, Senior Managers, and non-engineering functions such as Product and Program Management.
Oversee data governance: Establish robust data compliance and governance frameworks for a massive, global data footprint.
Navigate and execute: Guide the team through organizational change while maintaining global alignment and building effective processes and outcomes.

What You Bring

Experience: 15+ years in data or software engineering, including 8+ years leading and scaling engineering organizations, with experience managing managers (Directors and Senior Managers).
Executive leadership: A track record leading global, matrixed teams of tenured leaders, with strong executive presence across studios, labels, and executive stakeholders.
Technical pedigree: A deep engineering background—including hands-on IC experience earlier in your career—with the depth to make architectural calls across a modern cloud data stack: cloud data warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery), streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Spark), orchestration and transformation (Airflow, dbt), and lakehouse/ML platforms (Databricks, SageMaker). Highly technical product leaders on the data side are also encouraged to apply.
AI/ML expertise: A proven, hands-on track record of shipping AI/ML systems to production—feature/training pipelines, deployment, and monitoring. Familiarity with modern LLM and agentic patterns (RAG, semantic layers, MCP-style tooling) is a strong need. This is a critical, non-negotiable requirement.
Platform depth: Demonstrated ownership of large-scale, cloud-native data platforms on AWS—modeling, batch and streaming pipelines, cost/performance optimization, reliability (SLOs, observability), and data quality at scale.
Semantic layer & governance: Experience scaling semantic/metrics layers and self-serve analytics (dbt, metrics stores, Tableau/Lightdash) and familiarity with experimentation platforms and data privacy/compliance frameworks.
Cross-functional leadership: Comfort managing non-engineering functions (Product and Production) and translating technical concepts into clear business value for executives and non-engineers.

Bonus Points

Previous leadership experience within the gaming industry. Candidates from top-tier tech, consumer tech, or large-scale enterprise tech are also highly encouraged to apply.

new_jobs.description:
Level:
Executive

Location:
Remote | Canada or USA (Travel to our Ottawa HQ and Toronto Hub Required)

Reports To:
Michael Matta, Chief Executive Officer

Type:
Permanent | Full-Time

About Solink

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most
. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster
by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!

The Role

Solink is at an inflection point in our growth journey. As Chief Financial Officer, you'll lead our financial strategy as we continue to scale and prepare the company for its next chapter of growth.

This is a critical leadership role, shaping both the day-to-day financial operations and the long-term strategic direction of the company. You'll bring a strong operational and strategic background, proven success scaling technology businesses, and the judgment to know when to zoom in on the details and when to zoom out to see the bigger picture.

What You'll Do

Lead the Finance Team: Oversee and develop the leaders of Solink’s FP&A and Accounting functions. Set clear priorities, strengthen collaboration between the teams, and hold them accountable for accurate, timely work and useful business insights.
Get Close to the Work: Understand how financial work gets done today, identify where processes break down, and work alongside the team to fix them. Bring the judgment and willingness to dig into details that a growing business needs.
Improve Processes and Systems: Simplify and document core finance processes, improve data quality, and introduce automation where it reduces manual work and errors. Build a function that can scale without relying on workarounds or individual heroics.
Strengthen Planning and Decision-Making: Guide the established FP&A function in delivering reliable budgets, forecasts, financial models, and analysis. Partner with leaders across Solink to turn that work into clear decisions and accountability for results.
Build Trust in Financial Reporting: Lead the Accounting function through a strong close, audit, and reporting cadence. Strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with applicable GAAP/IFRS requirements while giving leaders confidence in the numbers.
Support Capital Strategy and Investor Relationships: Partner with the CEO and Board on financial strategy, capital needs, financing opportunities, and investor communications. Ensure Solink has the financial discipline and information needed to evaluate future opportunities.
Evaluate Strategic Opportunities: Assess potential acquisitions and partnerships, including due diligence, financial modelling, and the practical work required to integrate them successfully.

Role Expectations

This is an E3 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level own company-wide outcomes, set the strategy for their function, and operate with broad autonomy in partnership with the CEO, the executive team, and the Board.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

Act as a full strategic partner to the CEO and the Board, not only as a steward of the numbers.
Build and develop a finance organization that scales ahead of the business, hiring and coaching leaders who raise the bar.
Bring financial discipline to company-wide decisions on pricing, investment, headcount, and market expansion.
Own the accuracy and credibility of forecasting, reporting, and board materials.
Prepare the company for its next financing or strategic event well before it is needed.

What success looks like:

Forecasting and planning the executive team and Board trust and act on.
The systems, controls, and team in place to operate credibly at $200M+ in revenue.
Solink positioned and diligence-ready for its next strategic chapter.

What You Bring

Must-Have:

10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience, with prior scale-up CFO experience.
Proven track record scaling SaaS or technology companies from ~$50M to $200M+ revenue, with experience navigating different exit paths.
Deep FP&A expertise with strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities.
Direct experience with late-stage fundraising (Series C/D/E) or public markets experience.
Strong command of SaaS metrics and recurring revenue models.
Knowledge of GAAP/IFRS, compliance frameworks, and audit oversight.
Inspirational leader with the ability to develop high-performing finance teams.

Nice-to-Have:

M&A experience across due diligence, valuation, and post-close integration.
Experience in a Canadian company with US and international operations, including multi-currency and cross-border tax considerations.

Security Requirements

Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;
Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States.
Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.
Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.
Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.
Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.
Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.
Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need.
Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.
Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.
Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.
Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

Intro Call with Our Talent Team
Interview with the Hiring Manager
Interview with Senior Director, People & Culture and Chief Corporate & Legal Officer (Individual 45-Minute Slots)
Final Interviews with Two Board Members
Reference Checks
Offer & Onboarding

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How To Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink
uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

new_jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director
new_jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director – AI Innovation Teams

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our new AI Innovation teams in Toronto—a bold initiative building the AI-powered future of financial analysis. We're not fine-tuning existing models or optimizing yesterday's algorithms. We're architecting the next generation: sophisticated agentic AI systems, intelligent automation that thinks, and ML capabilities that will redefine how credit analysis happens and how global financial markets consume insights.

This is AI's moment at Fitch, and we're moving decisively. We have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and we're establishing Toronto as our AI innovation center. As a Lead ML Engineer, you'll be a technical champion driving this transformation—building breakthrough ML systems that others will study, mentoring engineers who will become tomorrow's AI leaders, and establishing patterns that will scale across the organization. You're joining at the perfect inflection point: early enough to architect foundational decisions, resourced enough to execute boldly.

We need ML technologists who see greenfield opportunities as fuel rather than fear—whether you're an ML architect ready to design intelligent systems from first principles, an AI engineering leader who translates research breakthroughs into production reality, or a seasoned practitioner who recognizes that this moment demands courage over caution. If you're motivated by "let's prove this is possible" rather than "we need more data before we decide," this is a high-impact role where you'll spend less time justifying AI's potential and more time realizing it—alongside exceptional engineers who share your conviction that we're building something significant.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to remain deeply hands-on while operating at a senior level. You will contribute technical expertise, influence decision-making through strong engineering judgment, and partner closely with engineering leaders, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities

What We Offer

Ground-floor ML leadership with enterprise resources – Define the ML architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for Fitch's AI future while having the compute, research budgets, and organizational backing that most AI startups would envy; mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the most challenging technical problems
Build breakthrough ML systems that matter – Develop net-new generative AI platforms, multi-agent orchestration systems, and intelligent automation that will process billions in credit decisions; experiment with frontier models, novel architectures, and unconventional approaches; see your ML innovations directly impact how global financial markets operate
Access to cutting-edge ML infrastructure and research – Work with the latest LLMs, fine-tune foundation models, leverage enterprise-scale GPU clusters, experiment with emerging frameworks before they're mainstream, and collaborate with academic ML researchers; substantial conference and training budgets to stay at the forefront of AI innovation
Toronto as Fitch's AI center of excellence – Join our strategic investment in Toronto—one of the world's premier AI research hubs—where you'll connect with Vector Institute researchers, attend cutting-edge ML meetups, and be part of the ecosystem that's defining the future of applied AI
Shape ML governance and standards for an organization – Establish the ML engineering practices, model governance frameworks, and AI integration patterns that will guide Fitch's AI transformation; your architectural decisions will influence how a global financial services leader approaches intelligent systems
Real production impact with sophisticated ML challenges – Build ML systems that analysts and financial professionals actually use daily; solve hard problems at the intersection of NLP, document intelligence, reasoning systems, and production-scale deployment; measure your impact in both model performance and business outcomes
Accelerated career trajectory in AI leadership – High visibility to C-suite executives making billion-dollar strategic decisions; clear advancement paths to Principal ML Architect or AI Research Lead roles; opportunity to establish yourself as a recognized voice in financial AI and earn a reputation that opens doors across the industry

We'll Count On You To

Build transformative ML systems from the ground up – Design and architect net-new generative AI solutions, agentic workflows, and intelligent platforms using advanced ML frameworks (PyTorch, etc.), large language models, and emerging AI technologies that fundamentally change how analysts work and how Fitch operates
Drive breakthrough AI innovation and experimentation boldly – Lead exploration of generative AI, multi-agent systems, RAG architectures, model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and other emerging ML technologies; create cutting-edge proofs-of-concept; evaluate what's transformative versus what's hype; and turn research into production-quality AI capabilities
Define ML technical vision and architecture for the future – Shape architectural decisions for ML systems, establish ML engineering standards, drive technology and framework choices, and influence how Fitch approaches intelligent platforms and AI governance across the organization
Lead through innovation, influence, and mentorship – Mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while partnering with product squads, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate ambitious AI ideas into elegant technical solutions; foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and calculated risk-taking
Champion ML excellence while moving fast – Balance innovation velocity with ML engineering best practices; implement robust CI/CD pipelines for ML systems; develop scalable APIs (FastAPI, etc.) for model deployment; solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and production systems; and build solutions that are both breakthrough and reliable
Drive ML governance and operational excellence – Ensure adherence to AI/ML governance guidelines, monitor SLAs for AI solutions, optimize model performance and reliability, and translate complex ML concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences across distributed teams
Shape team culture and technical direction – Help define how our AI innovation teams operate, what "good" looks like for ML engineering, and how we balance exploration with delivery; model the curiosity, boldness, and technical rigor needed to succeed in a greenfield ML innovation environment

What You Need To Have

Deep ML technical expertise – 12+ years of professional experience building production AI/ML systems, with strong proficiency in Python, ML algorithms (from classical techniques to deep learning), and modern ML frameworks; proven track record of delivering advanced generative AI and ML solutions
ML architectural mastery and greenfield experience – Demonstrated experience designing scalable ML systems from scratch; deep understanding of ML system architecture, model deployment patterns, and the ability to make bold architectural decisions for AI platforms in ambiguous environments
Advanced generative AI expertise – Extensive hands-on experience developing and integrating generative AI solutions, working with large language models, building agentic systems, implementing RAG architectures, and training/fine-tuning neural networks using frameworks like PyTorch
Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field
Production ML engineering excellence – Deep understanding of ML operations, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), workflow orchestration (Airflow), automated testing for ML systems, and API development for model deployment
Technical leadership and influence – Track record of mentoring and coaching engineers, driving ML initiatives in fast-moving environments, leading through technical excellence and influence rather than authority, and building credibility through results and vision
Innovation and experimentation mindset – Demonstrated history of exploring emerging ML technologies, building AI proofs-of-concept, learning from failures, and translating cutting-edge research into production systems; comfort with ambiguity and rapid technological change
Outstanding collaboration and communication – Ability to articulate ML technical vision to diverse audiences, work effectively with product squads and business partners, translate complex AI/ML concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives

What Would Make You Stand Out

Cutting-edge AI research to production experience – Track record of taking breakthrough AI capabilities from research/prototype to production-scale deployment; experience supporting seamless transitions from experimentation to enterprise-grade ML systems with real users
ML thought leadership and technical strategy – History of establishing technical direction for ML initiatives, contributing to open-source ML projects, speaking at AI/ML conferences, publishing research, or writing about practical applications of emerging AI technologies
Multi-agent and agentic systems expertise – Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, agentic workflows, tool-using AI systems, or complex AI orchestration platforms that go beyond simple LLM integrations
Advanced cloud-native ML infrastructure – Deep expertise building sophisticated ML infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, model serving platforms, and cloud-native AI systems at scale; experience optimizing cost and performance of production LLM deployments
Financial services or analytical domain knowledge – Understanding of analytical workflows, credit analysis processes, regulatory requirements, financial data products, or how ML enables better financial decision-making; familiarity with credit ratings agencies is a significant advantage
Startup or innovation team experience – History of building greenfield ML products, working in fast-paced AI innovation environments, or being part of 0-to-1 ML initiatives within larger organizations where you shaped technical direction
Toronto AI/ML community connection – Active participation in Toronto's AI/ML research or engineering communities, connections to academic ML research groups, or strong interest in being part of Toronto's world-class AI ecosystem

If you're ready to build transformative ML systems with organizational backing, talented colleagues, and the resources to succeed—this is the moment to join us.

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

About Fitch Group

Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings | Fitch Solutions | Fitch Learning.

For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com | www.fitchsolutions.com | www.fitchlearning.com

new_jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We have an amazing opportunity for a motivated operational Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the organization’s strategic financial management, maintain stakeholder confidence and ensure the integrity of publicly filed financial statements. Reporting to the CEO, the CFO will provide timely and accurate financial information to support decisions concerning the organization’s short-, medium- and long-term direction. The CFO will provide advice and quarterly updates to the Audit Committee and Board of Directors, with additional updates as required.

The CFO will oversee accounting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, liquidity management and financial systems across Nanalysis and its subsidiaries, including KPrime and RS2D. Working closely with operational leaders, the CFO will maintain effective internal financial controls, oversee consolidated financial reporting and ensure compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

THE ORGANIZATION

Nanalysis Scientific Corp. is a publicly traded company listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the ticker symbol NSCI. The company develops and manufactures compact nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) instruments and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) technology for laboratory and industrial applications. Its products serve customers across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, energy, chemicals, food science and materials, as well as government and university research laboratories worldwide.

Through RS2D, Nanalysis also offers magnetic resonance electronics and software for NMR and MRI applications. The group includes KPrime Technologies, which focuses on Canadian aviation and urban security markets, providing maintenance services for passenger screening and imaging equipment and offering security technology solutions.

Nanalysis operates across Scientific Equipment and Security Services. Its services business includes a long-term, $160 million contract with the Canadian Air Transport Security Authority (CATSA) to maintain security scanners at more than 80 Canadian airports.
For more information, please visit: www.nanalysis.com

PRIMARY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

Participate in strategic business, financial, and human resource planning, coordinating the preparation of budgets for the organization and commercial bank.
Lead an accounting/finance department of fifteen accounting and varied staff locally and internationally, and play a role in the overall administration and management of the organization.
Responsible for day-to-day financial operations including: operating cash-flow, management of the general ledger, banking, investments, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, government reporting, and remitting.
Driving and overseeing the upgrading of accounting systems, the implementation of a new Microsoft-based ERP, that is suitable for the size and nature of Nanalysis and its subsidiaries.
Monitor revenue and expenditures as compared to budget and explain variances.
Provision of appropriate performance reports to the various departments within the organization, including subsidiaries.
Skills and experience in timely consolidation of quarterly financial statements required.
In addition to providing financial reports to CEO and the Board of Directors, the CFO will provide the management team with the financial and business process information they require to do their jobs optimally.
Preparation of quarterly F/S for external distribution along with meaningful MD&A.
Management of NCIB as directed by CEO and Board of Directors, and preparation of AIF and any regulatory documents required by the organization, as determined by the CEO and Board of Directors.
As authorized by the organization’s CEO and Board of Directors, endorse cheques, contracts, and other legal documents on behalf of the organization.
Liaise with external financial accountants and ensure production of annual audited financial statements.
Oversee the financial elements of strategic partnerships with outside entities.
Work with HR to maintain personnel files with employment information and salary verification; track vacation, leave, sick time, and overtime.
Review and challenge external invoices from accounting and legal firms as necessary.
Coordinate all payroll requirements, including new hires, terminations, and salary adjustments.
Administer employee benefits plan.
Maintain banking relations, including maintaining operating lines of credit that are required for business operations.
Liaise with legal advisors on financial matters.
Lead financial Due Diligence and ultimately integration for an aggressive multi-pronged acquisition strategy over the coming five years.
Other related work may be required.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum of 15 years of broad financial management experience, preferably with familiarity with public-company markets and M&A.
Experience managing finance (accounting, budgeting, control, reporting) for start-ups and/or small manufacturing organizations with international clients and multiple funding sources, including federal, provincial, and international governments, is preferred.
Professional accounting designation (CPA) with a related university degree.
Proficiency in accounting software (e.g. QuickBooks) and electronic payment systems.
Experience with ERP implementation and maintenance.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite as well as familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics.
Ability to undertake occasional business-related travel.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Excellent organizational, analytical, research, and time management skills.
Ability to work with an open and consultative communication style.
Capacity to work both independently and as a strong team player and leader, demonstrating flexibility, adaptability, timeliness, and responsiveness.
Ability to set priorities, to act decisively, and to exercise a high degree of initiative, diplomacy, and judgment on a wide range of issues, especially when dealing with confidential matters.
Superior skills in building and maintaining productive and supportive working relationships and dealing with others in a professional and respectful manner.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
